controller.bootstrap_unit: ordered complete valid forecast days; overlapping noncircular moving segments; shared resampled positions across challengers; gaps do not break a segment
controller.lcb_quantile: sorted replicate order statistic at max(0, ceil(alpha_per_challenger*resamples)-1), no interpolation
controller.switch_rule: LCB strictly greater than delta; choose greatest LCB; tie nearest current lambda then configured level order; insufficient evidence keeps trained active state

execution_choice.causal_order: forecast all candidates and persist before label; score/update only after complete 24-hour label arrival; decision at block end affects future forecasts; preserve selected trained model and optimizer; audit never feeds policy

aliases.without_confidence: online_best_lambda if locked delta is exactly zero
aliases.seasonal_naive_seed_views: one deterministic physical run at seed 7; seed 11 and 19 are aliases, not independent replications

analysis.unit: entity/station first within dataset, city, history budget and method
analysis.forecast_metrics: for each run, sum absolute and squared original-kWh errors across all complete scored 24-hour days; MAE=sum_abs/scored_hours; RMSE=sqrt(sum_sq/scored_hours)
analysis.pairing: same entity, budget and seed; exact common scored-day IDs and label SHA; changed input/source/target binding or no common scored day blocks the pair
analysis.aggregation: equal seed means within a station, then equal station means within dataset/city/budget/method/reference; never treat repeated hours, days or seeds as independent stations
analysis.mae_gain_kwh: paired reference MAE minus method MAE
analysis.transfer_gain: (Target-only MAE - source-using method MAE)/Target-only MAE only when Target-only MAE>0; otherwise null with absolute difference retained
analysis.negative_transfer_rate: fraction of paired scorable stations with station-mean source-using method MAE worse than Target-only MAE; report numerator and denominator
analysis.uncertainty: for 1-5 scorable stations, exact n^n station bootstrap of station seed-mean gain with replacement; 95% linear-interpolated percentile interval; descriptive with small n and repeated-time dependence stated
analysis.controller: report switch count, decisions, insufficient-evidence blocks, selected levels, candidate/audit update and inference counts, and post-switch old-policy audit difference only on paired scored days
analysis.cost: separate Source and Target initialization, replay/candidates/audit, provider wall time, archive/upload and independent readback; preserve device and measured denominators; no unmatched hardware ranking
analysis.null_policy: zero scored complete days gives null MAE/RMSE/gain; no paired scored days is an explicit blocked pair; unavailable/late/incomplete labels stay null, never zero or imputed; missing method/city/seed cells remain explicit
analysis.context: weekday/weekend and local target-hour slices are descriptive; sparse/dense threshold remains unresolved until Development-pinned and is not an executable subgroup claim
